English: Walled Garden Patch
A makeshift earthwork enclosure to grow hardy herbs and roots, surrounded by simple wicker fencing.
Irrigated Bed
Raised soil beds with ditches to guide water, allowing more diverse crops to flourish even in dry seasons.
Fruit Pavilion
A tented pavilion providing shelter for fruit trees and vines, guarded from wind and sand, offering sweet harvests.
Flower Stand
Raised flowerbeds and trellises, tended for beauty as well as subtle signals to allies and rivals alike.
Scented Room
A richly adorned tent or chamber filled with aromatic blossoms and herbs, fostering unity and courtly intrigue.
Courtyard Hall
A central open hall surrounded by sheltered arcades, gathering the clan for feasts, judgments, and council.
Windcatcher Pavilion
Tall, vented towers and canvas structures that cool and ventilate, making the central encampment bearable through the fiercest heat.
Fountain Garden
A lavish display of waterworks, with trickling fountains and marble basins, symbolizing power and bringing life to all who gather.
Rose Chamber
A perfumed sanctuary lined with rare roses, reserved for the ruler and honored guests. Politics, poetry, and alliances blossom here.
Iranian Paradise Pavilion
A sprawling, walled garden of splendor, with pavilions, pools, and shaded paths evoking Irans legendary paradise. Immense prestige and unity flow from this wondrous seat.
